messages:
Sara (Sales): Quick sync — Helix wants to kick off the POC next week but procurement listed blockers: net45 PO, MSA redlines (they added HSM/KMS language), DPA needs EU data residency, and CFO is pushing prepay vs invoice. Can Legal/Finance advise? cc Marco for tech tradeoffs.
Marco (SE): Confirmed HSM requirement — they want HSM-backed keys for key material. For Private we can do customer-managed HSM; for Hosted we can offer BYOK with HSM-backed KMS. If they insist on HSM addendum, we'll need signed HSM attestation.
Jon (Legal): Please attach the customer's redline. We need to review the exact wording around custody and indemnity. High level: we accept BYOK but resist being named custodian. Suggest we require attestation + limit liability for key compromise to direct damages only.
Sara (Sales): Uploaded the redline here: https://drive.redwood/helix/redline_v2 — they also asked for a provisional SLA of 99.9% for the POC duration. Any chance to provide temp SLA?
Priya (Finance): Net45 is acceptable if we have a signed PO and exec ok. If they prefer prepay, we can do a 25% partial prepayment for the POC phase. Procurement also asked for SOC2 report + organization chart for KYC.
Marco (SE): Tech note — standing up a Private VPC + HSM integration is ~10 business days. If they want next-week start, recommend Hosted+BYO KMS for initial eval; switches to Private later.
Jon (Legal): Agreed. For Hosted+BYOK update DPA to call out BYOK with HSM attestation and normal breach notification timelines. Sara, can you push security questionnaire answers and the redlines?
Sara (Sales): Sent the security questionnaire responses (attached in drive). Also customer wants invoices issued to 'Helix EU Ltd' instead of US corp — any legal/billing issues?
Jon (Legal): Entity change is fine but requires EU invoicing addendum and tax/VAT handling confirmation. We'll review the redline that references HSM specifically and propose revised clause.
Priya (Finance): If invoiced to EU entity, routing/VAT needs handled; net45 still fine. Provide PO to eu-billing@redwood.ai. If they prepay, ops can issue a proforma invoice.
compliance-bot: SOC2 report (2025-06) uploaded to drive at /compliance/soc2/2025_redwood_soc2.pdf
Marco (SE): Heads up: if customer requests third-party HSM attestation, compliance needs 48hrs to pull vendor attestation and certs. Might delay POC by a few days.
Sara (Sales): Plan to propose: 1) start POC on Hosted with BYOK (HSM attestation requested), 2) offer 25% prepay option to satisfy CFO, 3) ask customer to send redlines + PO to eu-billing@redwood.ai, 4) Legal to propose revised HSM clause asap. I'll reply to Helix now. Thanks all.
Jon (Legal): I'll draft the HSM-friendly addendum and a short note on liability/attestation. ETA EOD.
Priya (Finance): I'll confirm invoicing flow and set up a provisional proforma if they choose prepay.
Sara (Sales): 👍 will update thread once they respond.
